## ANAPLASMA PHAGOCYTOPHILUM (HUMAN GRANULOCYTOTROPIC ANAPLASMOSIS)
## Treatment
[Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [DI]](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Doxycycline 100 mg IV q12h for 10 days ($$) [DI]](psjizid-doxycycline-100mg-iv-q12h)
